parsed.post: Discarding warmup 0.1: 0.8967 vs 0.8955. Testing depth6+warmup0.05 on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' as clean control, since '0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10. Requesting operator ruling on whether 0-10 is allowed before further tuning on the contaminated eval.
parsed.description: Clean-control run: keep depth 6 and warmup 0.05, but train on shards 0-9 to exclude the evaluation shard.
parsed.report_to_operator: Please rule whether TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is valid given EVAL_SHARD=10; training on the eval shard may leak validation data and invalidate recent results.
